description: This file defines the PromptEditorView React functional component, which provides a user interface for creating, editing, and managing prompts within a language model prompt management system. It includes state handling, UI layout, form controls, and interactions for prompt configuration and version management.

methods.name: getInitialPrompt
methods.description: Initializes the prompt state, parsing existing prompt data if available, or setting a default prompt template.

methods.name: getInitialVersionId
methods.description: Constructs a versioned ID for the prompt based on initial prompt data, supporting numbering and suffixes.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Appends a new message with role 'user' to the prompt's messages array.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Updates the content of a specified message in the prompt's message list.

methods.name: removeMessage
methods.description: Removes a message from the messages array if there is more than one message.

methods.name: moveMessage
methods.description: Rearranges the order of messages within the messages array.

methods.name: addTool
methods.description: Parses JSON input to add or update a tool in the prompt's tools list.

methods.name: removeTool
methods.description: Removes a tool from the tools list by index.

methods.name: openToolModal
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog for adding or editing a tool, optionally setting the editing index.

methods.name: handleLoadVersion
methods.description: Loads a specific prompt version into the editor, updating the prompt state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSaveClick
methods.description: Validates prompt data and triggers the save process, prompting for a name if necessary.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Performs the API call to save or update the prompt, depending on mode, and handles success/error notifications.

methods.name: getVersionNumber
methods.description: Extracts version number from a prompt ID string.

methods.name: extractTemplateVariables
methods.description: Scans prompt content for template variable placeholders and generates example values for preview purposes.
